caption: The drawing depicts a simplified floral composition consisting of three yellow flowers with brown centers attached to a single brown branch that splits into three directions. Each flower has multiple pointed petals, with one large flower positioned near the center and two smaller flowers extending from the left and right sides of the main branch. Surrounding the branch, there are six blue-green elongated leaves, with three leaves on each side of the branch. The background consists of a light beige color with a slightly darker beige rectangle positioned behind the flowers and a faint, wide diagonal band of pale blue towards the bottom. Scattered throughout the drawing are small, irregularly shaped, reddish-pink ovals that resemble petals or confetti. In the lower left corner, there is handwritten text.
title: Colcha
